about.title: What is Diabetes?
about.text: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic condition characterized by elevated blood glucose levels. Type 2 diabetes, the most common form, develops when the body can't effectively use insulin. Early detection and lifestyle modifications can prevent or delay complications.

about.title: What is Migraine?
about.text: Migraine is a neurological disorder characterized by intense, debilitating headaches often accompanied by sensitivity to light, sound, and nausea. Understanding personal triggers and early warning signs is essential for effective management and prevention.

about.title: What is PCOD?
about.text: Polycystic Ovarian Disease (PCOD) is a hormonal disorder affecting women of reproductive age. It's characterized by imbalanced hormone levels and can impact fertility, metabolism, and overall health. Early detection and lifestyle management are crucial.
